descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Headquartered in Cluj-Napoca, Romania, CodeAgency is a privately-owned company made by engineers. We are committed to building apps with a robust technical foundation delivering the outstanding user experience the customers deserve with an exceptional attention to details.
 About the project 
 You'll be working on a project in the construction industry, developed with the latest web technologies. The front-end is built with React for web and React Native for mobile and sustained by a back-end developed with Node.js, GraphQL and the PostgreSQL database.
 Your role 
Contributing to the development and testing of the project, focusing on delivering clean code and high quality features.
Constantly updating technical knowledge and skills.
Interacting with all stakeholders to bring the product to the next level.
Problem-solving and lateral thinking as part of a team, or individually, to meet the project needs.
 Qualifications 
5+ years of experience in web applications built with React and JavaScript/TypeScript.
Up to date with modern HTML & CSS practices.
React Native experience is a plus.
Node.js and GraphQL experience is a plus.
Knowledge of PostgreSQL or other relational SQL databases.
Understanding of the Git way of working.
Positive and collaborative attitude.
Team player, having the curiosity and passion for continuous improvement.
Fluent in English.
 Additional info 
The job is fully remote, but we are looking for candidates from the Cluj-Napoca Metropolitan Area so we can get together once in a while.
The development is done on macOS and you'll receive a MacBook Pro workstation.
